source_population_description: 42,048 deduplicated claim/evidence records drawn from 61 real, already-persisted TradingAgents research run directories under outputs/runs/ (structured_agent_outputs.json), spanning 8 tickers (AMD, GOOGL, MSFT, MU, NVDA, QQQ, SNDK, TSM), after excluding all 838 known-touched claim_ids (Holdouts #1-#5 + the 'old-50' set) and filtering to analysis_eligible, non-placeholder claims with normalized-text length >= 15 chars and no exact-text or claim_id duplicate within the pool. No new research run, no TradingAgents invocation, and no Provider call was used to build this pool.
leakage_exclusion_rules: Exact claim_id match against the 838-item known-touched union (Holdouts #1-#5 + old-50) -- 0 matches found in the final 300
Exact-text (claim+evidence, normalized) duplicate within the pool and within the selected 300 -- 0 found

Verbatim substring search of the first 50 characters of every one of the 300 claims against all files under tests/ and against comqutor_alpha/structure_engine/week2_llm.py (the prompt source) -- 0 hits

Candidate 1/2 design artifacts (v0_2_day4_alpha_holdout_failure_analysis.json, v0_2_day4c_candidate1_regression_analysis.json, v0_2_alpha_prompt_candidate2.json) reference only Holdout #4 claim_ids, all of which are in the excluded touched union -- 0 overlap by construction
stratification_note: The 300-item candidate pool was stratified by ticker only (flat quota per ticker, non-model metadata), never by COMQUTOR's own predicted Alpha. The dev/final/reserve 3-way split was then produced by a single further seeded shuffle and positional slice of the full 300, which guarantees exact target split sizes (100/150/50) but only approximate (not exact) per-ticker proportionality within each split -- disclosed honestly per Section 6's own instruction, rather than claimed as precise stratification it is not.
